verdict.rationale: Hardware-backed SSH keys are a fair question for a FIDO security key, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions SSH, sk-ssh keys, PIV, or OpenPGP. The documentation covers only FIDO/U2F sign-in to Google and other CTAP1-compatible sites, which is a different story and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, my SSH keys can be hardware-backed on the device — via FIDO2 sk-ssh keys, PIV, or OpenPGP — so server access requires a physical touch
